opportunities.title: Authors' Contingency Fund

amount.raw: Grants range in value and are designed to meet immediate need.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all professional authors resident in the UK or British citizens (fiction writers, illustrators, literary translators, scriptwriters, poets, journalists and others) for whom author-related activities make up a substantial amount of their annual income. Not open to editors, copywriters, or salaried journalists. Membership of the Society of Authors not required.
opportunities.summary: Small, short-term hardship grants to authors in financial difficulty, designed to meet immediate need (e.g. lost income, project shortfalls, illness impact, sudden domestic changes, or one-off expenses such as a boiler or laptop).

opportunities.title: Authors' Foundation
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to writers who have been previously published or have a contract for their project with a commercial UK or Irish publisher/producer. For book projects: commissioned by a commercial UK/Irish publisher, or no contractual commitment but at least one commercially published book with strong likelihood of next book being published. For script projects: previously professionally performed work, or under contract for a script to be professionally performed. Hybrid/self-published books not eligible. Editors not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help develop a work-in-progress (fiction, non-fiction, poetry, and script projects), for important research, travel or other general expenditure. Applicants are also automatically considered for related awards (Eric Ambler, Taner Baybars, John Brooks, Antonia Fraser, Arthur Welton, Great Britain Sasakawa).

opportunities.title: Strachey Trust Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (as defined by SoA criteria for Full Membership, though membership not required) who are UK resident or British citizens, working on a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication, wishing to access UK-based archives/collections. Applications preferred to fund at least 25% of costs themselves.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable authors to travel to a UK or Republic of Ireland archive or collection to research manuscript material for a specific full-length literary project, covering travel, overnight accommodation, subsistence, childcare/carer support, companion costs, access needs, copyright permission fees.

opportunities.title: K Blundell Trust
opportunities.eligibility_summary: British authors under the age of 40 on Sunday 1 March 2026, British by birth and currently resident in the UK, with a previous work (sole author) published with a commercial UK publisher. Accepts fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects. Hybrid/self-published not eligible. Editors not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Work-in-progress grants for British authors under 40 whose work aims to increase social awareness. Fund has closed and will re-open for applications in 2027.

opportunities.title: Society of Authors' Access Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (anyone who creates work for publication, broadcast or performance), UK and Irish residents and British and Irish citizens. No membership required but must meet SoA membership criteria. One grant per calendar year; preference to those who have not received funds previously.
opportunities.summary: Grants for travel, subsistence, childcare or access needs for events, residencies and retreats, including travel to events, residency/retreat fees, childcare/carer support, companion costs, and other access needs. Fund is closed and expected to re-open for applications in 2027.
